item.title: Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman Equation: Reinforcement Learning and Diffusion Models
item.description:
📝 Consider a Markov decision process with state space $\mathcal X$, action space $\mathcal A$, transition kernel $P(\cdot\mid x,a)$, reward function $r(x,a)$, and discount factor $\gamma\in(0,1)$. \tag{Bellman equation} $$This says: choose the action that maximizes immediate reward plus continuation value. The associated value function is$$ V(x):=\sup_\pi \mathbb{E}\Big[\int_0^\infty e^{-\rho t}r(X_t,a_t)\,dt \Big| X_0=x\Big] $$Theorem (Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman equation for a controlled diffusion).
🔗 Read more: https://dani2442.github.io/posts/continuous-rl/

item.title: I am definitely missing the pre-AI writing era
item.description:
📝 Have some think pieces on popular sites, and other personal blog that I used to share. Sorry that this sounds like a rant, well, it is one. Cause those words, that the AI told you: sound wrong or aggressive or less formal, are the ones that carry the ''emotions", you ought to share.
🔗 Read more: https://www.lesswrong.com/posts/BJ4pnropWdnzzgeJc/i-am-definitely-missing-the-pre-ai-writing-era
